rules.statement: A personal servitude created by grant, unless it is expressly stated to be assignable, terminates on the death of the individual in whose favour it was created.
rules.supporting_quote: "Unless a personal servitude conferred by grant is expressly stated to be assignable, it generally terminates on the death of the individual in Whose favour it is created. (Maasdorp (ibid) p. 169-Voet 7. 1. 1.)"
